The '''Poppy''' is a [[Flowers|flower]] that can be [[Crops|grown]] from [[Poppy Seeds]] in 7 days. Unlike all other flowers, Poppies are a [[Friendship#Universal Hates|universally hated gift]]; [[Penny]], who loves Poppies, is the only exception.

If placed within proper range of a [[Bee House#Range|Bee House]] (5 squares in any cardinal direction), a Poppy will cause [[Honey|Poppy Honey]] to be produced, increasing the honey base value from {{Price|100}} to {{Price|380}}.

Poppies can be purchased from the [[Traveling Cart]] for {{Tprice|140}}.

==Tailoring==
Poppy can be used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the dyeable [[Tailoring#Pants|Pleated Skirt]]. [[File:Pleated Skirt.png|36px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as an orange dye at the dye pots, located in [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house, [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Notes==
*Poppies have an equal chance of being one of three different colors. Poppies of different colors will occupy different slots in inventory or chests. Three colors × four [[Crops#Crop Quality|quality]] levels = 12 possible spaces used.
:[[File:PoppyColors.png]]
